name: app-dark-problems-and-solutions-tab-cards-with-progress-plane
title: Dark Problems and Solutions Tab Cards
whatItIs: A dark slate slide titled Problem & Solutions with a plane-marked progress bar and two frosted cards with folder-style tabs, a red-tinted Problems tab card about a complex booking flow and a green-tinted Solutions tab card about simplifying the journey, each with an italic subhead and a pill tag.
whatItMeans: Red and green tabs colour-code the pair, and the folder shape makes each card feel like a file.
techniques: Folder tab labels tinted red and green
Frosted dark cards with subtle borders
Italic subhead beneath a heavy title

vocabulary.definition: A raised tab on a card's top edge that labels it.
Using colour to mark meaning like problem or solution.
A translucent blurred card on a dark background.
